items.title: Spectral-index source balls for compact operators
items.statement:
Assume Countable Choice. Let $X$ and $Y$ be real or complex Hilbert spaces over the same scalar field and let $K:X	o Y$ be compact. Write $\kappa:=\|K\|$, $S:=K^*K$, and $|K|:=S^{1/2}$, and let $\Lambda_K$ be zero together with the positive eigenvalues of $|K|$. An admissible spectral index is a bounded function $\psi:\Lambda_K	o[0,\infty)$ with $\psi(0)=0$. Define $\psi(|K|)$ by the compact spectral multiplier of $S$ with scalar function $t\mapsto\psi(\sqrt t)$. For $ho>0$ define $X_{\psi,ho}(K):=\{\psi(|K|)w:w\in X,\ \|w\|_X\leho\}$. For $
u>0$, $\psi_
u(t)=t^
u$ defines the power source ball $X_{
u,ho}(K)$. If $\kappa>0$ and $q>0$, define the logarithmic spectral-index candidate by $\psi_{\log,q}(0)=0$ and $\psi_{\log,q}(t)=(1+\log(\kappa/t))^{-q}$ for positive $t\in\Lambda_K$; when it is bounded, it defines $X_{\log,q,ho}(K)$.

items.title: Centered conditional modulus of continuity
items.statement: For a compact operator $K:X\to Y$ between real or complex Hilbert spaces over the same scalar field, write $N(K):=\{x\in X:Kx=0\}$. For a set $M$ with $0\in M\subseteq N(K)^\perp$ and $\delta\ge0$, define $\varepsilon_K(M,\delta):=\sup\{\|x\|_X:x\in M,\ \|Kx\|_Y\le\delta\}\in[0,+\infty]$.

items.title: Index source elements are minimum-norm solutions
items.statement: Assume Countable Choice. Let $K:X\to Y$ be compact between real or complex Hilbert spaces over the same scalar field, let $\psi$ be a bounded nonnegative spectral index with $\psi(0)=0$, and let $x=\psi(|K|)w$ for some $w\in X$. Then $x\in N(K)^\perp$; consequently, among all $z\in X$ satisfying $Kz=Kx$, $x$ is the unique vector of minimum norm.

items.title: Polynomial singular decay with power and logarithmic source balls
items.statement:
For this example put $\mathbb N=\{1,2,\ldots\}$. On real $\ell^2(\mathbb N)$, let $e_j$ be the coordinate vectors and define $K_ax=(j^{-a}x_j)_{j\ge1}$ for $a>0$. For $
u,q,ho>0$, the power source ball $X_{
u,ho}(K_a):=\{|K_a|^
u w:\|w\|_2\leho\}$ has coordinates $x_j=j^{-a
u}w_j$, while the logarithmic source ball $X_{\log,q,ho}(K_a):=\{\psi_q(|K_a|)w:\|w\|_2\leho\}$, where $\psi_q(0)=0$ and $\psi_q(t)=(1+\log(1/t))^{-q}$ for $0<t\le1$, has coordinates $x_j=(1+a\log j)^{-q}w_j$. The operator is compact and injective with $\|K_a\|=1$. For the power ball the centered modulus has the bound in the conditional-modulus theorem, with equality at $\delta_j=ho j^{-a(
u+1)}$; this does not assert equality for every $\delta$.
